statusVocabulary.chưa thử: no run has been observed for this fixture; every fixture ships in this state
statusVocabulary.đạt có bằng chứng: a run exists whose artifact, command and environment are recorded in the evidence register
statusVocabulary.đạt có giới hạn: a run exists and a named limitation was observed and recorded
statusVocabulary.không hỗ trợ: no implementation path exists at the pinned commit; the product must not claim the capability

rules: Every fixture declares an expected result and an oracle before any run happens; a fixture that cannot state both is marked pending instead.
Generated fixtures are deterministic: fixed ids, fixed compression level, no timestamps, no host-dependent bytes.
Fixtures copied from upstream keep their origin, their commit and their third-party notice; their bytes are never edited in place.
A macro-bearing fixture is opened to check preservation only; no macro is ever executed.
Capability rows and fixtures reference each other in both directions; an orphan on either side fails the verifier.
Large-band fixtures live in the shared lab root, not in Git, and are recorded with the size they were generated at.
Nothing under an upstream ee/ path is copied, referenced or repackaged.
